title: Fence Fabricators and Installers: Align Salesforce Approved Configurations With NetSuite Sales Orders
summary: Keep approved fence and gate configurations linked to the correct NetSuite order revision.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Fence fabricators and installers should connect Salesforce's approved commercial configuration to NetSuite order and project records through a versioned handoff. Preserve dimensions, material, finish, gate requirements and the approved drawing reference at the level needed for production. Sales can manage the proposal, while engineering or fabrication review owns technical release and finance owns the commercial order. Two-way sync should expose the accepted state without letting a late CRM edit silently change released work.


Explore the complete[fencing fabrication and installation integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/fencing-fabrication-installation) for the systems and processes around this guide.
